prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1101; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
- The repair labor hours are a little high for this damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across the center and the trunk lid shows a creased lower edge, with the tail lamp assembly broken on the driver side. The pattern of damage lines up well with the reported impact, and no prior damage to the vehicle is known from the records available. The plan is to replace the bumper cover, repair the trunk lid, and install a new tail lamp assembly, followed by refinishing and a wheel alignment check. Two similar charges posted on the same day are currently under review. The labor hours on the estimate run a little high for this scope of work, so the shop has been asked to justify the figures before approval.
